snippet.title: The Incident at Galley House Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
In 1936, something terrible happened at Galley House. Decades later, with a strange contraption that reveals echoes of the past, you must uncover the truth behind this grisly mystery. 

From the team behind the acclaimed investigation game "The Roottrees are Dead" comes a new mystery based on the IGF-nominated text adventure "Type Help".

The Incident at Galley House will be released on Steam on July 14, 2026, with support for Windows, Mac and Linux, including Steam Deck.

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3641000/The_Incident_at_Galley_House/
